sentences.en: This boss has three stages, so conserve your health.
sentences.zh: 这个老板有三个阶段，所以要保重身体。

sentences.en: We must try to conserve our natural resources.
sentences.zh: 我们必须尽力保护我们的自然资源。

sentences.en: He conserved his energy for the next game.
sentences.zh: 他为下一场比赛保存了体力。

senses.zh: 保护，保存；节省，节约；使（量，如能量、质量）守恒；将……制成蜜饯
